Either the Nissan or Toyota. Once you go over 200k, replace the timing chain. Change oil religiously. Immediately upon receipt of vehicle, change the front brake pads yourself (if you cannot replace the front pads yourself you are unqualified to own a pickup.) If they are worn down to a nub, replace the rear as well. Any wear on the rotors replace them. Providing previous owners have not overheated the vehicle, you now pretty much own a new truck. After 300k the fuel injectors will need to be replaced.... don't use fuel injector cleaner... replace them. Fuel injector cleaner breaks down the rubber seals which cant take the abuse at that age. Edit: I have owned 2 Nissan small PU and am currently on my 1st Toyota. Toyota has more creature comforts.. worth it. If you have a choice, the king cab is the correct answer (full sized bed but with a place to put your tools when it rains.) Good luck in finding them if you live in Texas though.... they all get bought (people knock on my door and ask in broken English to buy my truck about once a month) and driven to Mexico where they are worth more than they are here.
